frontend.title: What can I create for you?
frontend.content_development: My interest in the intersection of technology and design led me to front-end development. I discovered a world where creativity naturally blends with logic. I was excited by the opportunity to bring my own designs to life and transform them into interactive websites.
frontend.content_webdesign: Today, I create and transform designs into responsive, functional solutions with a focus on user experience.

workflow.AI: A more efficient path to results
workflow.content_AI-agent: I also use artificial intelligence tools in my work. I view it as a useful aid, particularly for quickly editing and debugging code or automating routine tasks.
workflow.content_AI-creative: Collaborating with AI opens up new technological possibilities for me and provides inspiration for further development.
workflow.content_human: However, I always personally handle the designs, key decisions, and communication with the client.

UX.title: Design that makes sense
UX.content_design: If I had to characterize my creative style, I would choose the combination minimalist design.
UX.content_exp: I believe that every element—whether in digital or any other form—should have a clear purpose. My goal is to create visually clean and uncluttered websites where visitors feel at ease and can easily navigate the content.

graphic.title: Graphic & Print
graphic.content_graphic: I have been involved in Graphic design for many years. I design flyers, posters, invitations, business cards, logos and other products, especially of an advertising nature.
graphic.content_print: Thanks to my experience in print production, I understand not only the design itself but also the entire manufacturing process. I can prepare files for printing, plotter or laser cutting, textile printing, and engraving.
graphic.content_workflow: I place great emphasis on detail, the right choice of colors, materials and production technologies so that the final product it was professional and suited its purpose.
graphic.content_control: I carefully oversee every project from the design stage to final implementation.

offer.title: Let's create together
offer.content_build: Does my approach appeal to you? Let’s work together to turn ideas into products that are clear, visually appealing, and functional. Together, we will find a solution that resonates with your target audience and supports your business.
offer.content_form: Do you have an idea or a question, or would you simply like to discuss the possibilities? Please get in touch using no-obligation form. Filling it out takes about a minute, and it helps me better understand how I can assist you.

inspiration.title: Why the name SenseSpace?
inspiration.content: For me, the universe is a source of inspiration. I perceive it as a realm of infinite possibilities, profound meaning, and a freedom that naturally intertwines with immutable laws. In this space of mine in the universe, I want to create, experiment, and share projects that have meaning—for me and for others.

learn.title: What did I learn from this project?
learn.content_learn: This project helps me gain practical experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript—specifically DOM manipulation and the creation of event listeners, interactive components, modal windows, sliders, and responsive layouts using HTML/CSS Grid. I am improving my ability to debug code and solve common front-end development issues.
learn.content_living: This is a living project. I am gradually developing it based on what I learn. Do you have an idea for improvement or have you found a bug? I appreciate any constructive feedback.

bestshop.title: Responsive Website with Calculator
bestshop.technology: My first project using HTML, SCSS, and JavaScript.
bestshop.content_design: BestShop is a responsive landing page designed with a focus on clean aesthetics, a clear structure, and an intuitive user experience. Its visual style employs bold accents and modern elements that convey a sense of dynamic growth, service quality, and a rapid return on investment.
bestshop.content_code: During development, I focused on clean, well-organized code, responsive design across all devices, and intuitive controls. Thanks to JavaScript, the site also features an interactive calculator that helps visitors navigate the offerings.
